snippet.title: Kyoto Anomaly - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3631850/Kyoto_Anomaly

You find yourself trapped in a loop in the streets of Kyoto, trying to reach the temple of Hōkan-ji. Carefully observe your surroundings, and choose the right path... or be trapped forever.

Out May 26th, 2025
